name: qvt_six_species_charged_migration
claim: Real-qvt six-solved-plus-constrained-O2 transient heavy transport uses canonical charge-aware D_mix, mixture-averaged Einstein ion mobility (T_ion=T_g), Path-B charged-heavy electrostatic drift, and the common heavy-mass electromigration correction under the pinned face-flux identity; Poisson feedback is excluded and belongs to #16.
validator_redesign: accepted existing evidence; no arbitrary centroid threshold
mobility_model: mu_k = e*D_mix,k/(k_B*T_g), positive magnitude; charge sign owned by z_k
mobility_provenance: COMSOL Heavy Species Transport mixture-averaged default Einstein relation; #13 canonical charge-aware D_mix
migration_path: Path B only: bulk advection + QPXFVElectrostaticDrift + QPXFVHeavyMassElectromigrationCorrection
electric_field_contract: prescribed phi=-E0*x with E0=0.01 V/m, preserving accepted EVR2 representative forcing; no Poisson feedback in #15
zero_net_flux_contract: Pinned correction kernel reconstructs J_direct and applies J_corr=-J_direct; all six solved species receive the identical correction reconstruction; constrained O2 supplies the implied Q-1 residual flux, giving zero total heavy electromigration mass flux face-by-face.
recovery_change: E0_migration 500 -> 0.01 V/m only; no C++/mobility/timestep change
forcing_provenance: accepted EVR2 real-qvt representative field E0_migration=0.01 V/m
